violations.message: processes is pinned to 32 but 62 cores are budgeted on this machine; the run will leave capacity unused. This warning is EXPECTED on the canonical production configuration (configs/base_bs.yml pins processes: 32 against a 62-core budget on the run server) -- do not act on it there. processes is RESULT-AFFECTING, not operational: raising it changes the np.array_split person-chunk partition and the drawn seed count at synthesis/population/matched.py (parallel_statistical_matching) and synthesis/population/spatial/secondary/locations.py (execute), i.e. the statistical-matching and secondary-location realisations. Both sites declare it HASHED (not volatile), so raising the pin correctly devalidates those two stages and they recompute by themselves -- the recompute is the cost of a changed realisation, not a defect (ADR-0126, Decision 3). Raise the pin only deliberately.
